newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Jan-Oct non-CIS oil exports up 7.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian Jan-Oct non-CIS oil exports up 7.8 pct.

text.p: Russian crude oil exports over the first 10 months of 1996 to countries outside the Commonwealth of Independent States rose 7.8 percent on year-ago levels to 86.5 million tonnes, government figures showed on Wednesday.
The Foreign Economic Relations Ministry, in figures quoted by Interfax news agency, said total crude oil exports to all destinations over January-October rose 3.6 percent to 105.1 million tonnes.
Russia exported 43 percent of the oil it produced over this period.

Natural gas exports over the same period rose 4.1 percent to 160 billion cubic metres (bcm), with shipments to non-CIS customers up 6.3 percent to 105 bcm. Russia exported 43 percent of its gas production.

No absolute comparison figures were provided for 1995 levels. The ministry's figures often differ from those provided by the Fuel and Energy Ministry, the State Statistics Committee and the State Customs Committee.
